name: ip-drafting-engine
description: The drafting & strategy engine for intellectual-property work — after intake/research/analysis, this skill produces the concrete IP deliverables: application-oriented documents (patent claims/交底书 organization, trademark filing plans, copyright/软著 registration guidance), prosecution responses (OA答复/审查意见答复思路、异议/无效答辩要点), IP layout & portfolio design, enforcement documents (侵权警告函、投诉/维权方案、比对说明), IP strategy & governance plans, litigation venue/管辖 selection memos, and IP management-system建设 blueprints. All drafts carry a mandatory律师复核 reminder; the engine assists, it does not replace a licensed attorney or patent agent.
